actions.title: Add shortcut health + token-expiry alerts
actions.rationale: Broken ADLS/S3 shortcuts after token rotation are a loud OneLake complaint. A health signal and pre-expiry warning would prevent blank reports.

actions.title: Surface Direct Lake fallback as a first-class report banner
actions.rationale: Exec dashboard failures are blamed on Fabric BI when Direct Lake quietly falls back. Authors and viewers need an explicit, timestamped mode change.

actions.rationale: Hallucinated pipeline activities and double-counted DAX are high-visibility trust failures. Constrain generation to shipped APIs.

actions.title: Make Livy session reuse the default for notebooks
actions.rationale: Cold starts dominate Data Engineering negativity, while session reuse is called a game changer. Flip the default.

actions.rationale: Pipeline-success + empty lakehouse is a silent data-quality incident. Tie activity status to the commit.

actions.rationale: Latency spikes and silent partition drops showed up during launches. Operators want SLOs and a place dropped events go.
